info.title: Jiron Form Builder public API
info.description: What visitors' browsers and headless sites call: forms, their options, uploads, the checks of a page, entries and their receipts. Anonymous; errors are ProblemDetails with a stable code.

413.description: Payload Too Large: the body is longer than the endpoint takes (payload_too_large).

429.description: Too Many Requests: a rate limit is reached; Retry-After says when to send again (rate_limited).

500.description: Internal Server Error: something failed unexpectedly (server_error).

504.description: Gateway Timeout: the endpoint did not answer within its time limit (timeout).
